text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
N-N-No way, I'm still scared~!
If I ask such a stupid question, they'll just look at me like I'm crazy...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It's okay, calm down.
Come on, deep breath~♪

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Even if she's the 'Demon Drill Sergeant,'
there's no way she's given up on you!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Oops, Trainer!
Did you hear that?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Bubble-chan's Trainer might know!
The ruthless instructor, the "Ice Queen"...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "Instructors" who guide Umamusume
who don't have a trainer yet...
Some among them were infamous for being cold and strict.

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Without even cracking a smile, they calmly assign brutally heavy menus.
The atmosphere definitely doesn't let you ask about the details or intent...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: The atmosphere, huh... But still.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
If you have questions, I think it's a great chance to chat!
It means you've got 'something to talk about,' right?

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no... That's just sophistry.
There's no way they have time to bother with just me.
I should just keep quiet and do it without overthinking...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —In that case, maybe I should go talk to them.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Because you never know what someone is really like
until you actually talk to them!"

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
B-But no way...!
This is my problem...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me!
Ummm... Ah, maybe that person over there!

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, Bubble-san—wait, what are you doing, you...!
She looks busy right now, so wait until later!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
However, I'll ask them myself.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...So anyway, Instructor! Are you busy right now?

text_block_list.name: Drill Sergeant
text_block_list.text: It depends on what it's about. I have priorities.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"This won't take much of your time.
Here is what I need!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Regarding my training plan.
I'd really like to hear your thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Drill Sergeant
text_block_list.text:
Why?
You already have a Trainer assigned to you, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Wooww, you've already gotten straight to the point!
Didn't even have time to stop you♪

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Why do you look so happy, Laurel~!
Ugh, is she gonna be okay~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had been worried, but listening from afar made things clear.
The drill sergeant might be cold and strict, but she is a devoted teacher.
She stopped what she was doing and answered every question properly.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I see, doing anaerobic exercise before swimming, huh.
If so, this order certainly makes sense.
I've learned something today!

text_block_list.name: Drill Sergeant
text_block_list.text: Honestly, I assumed you'd understand this much. Leave no doubts during the planning stage. Now, any other questions?
choice_data_list: What a sincere and wonderful person...!

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Right... I think I understand
why they call her the "Empress."
Still, she's definitely a demon...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"The 'Demon Instructor'...? Sounds great!
Since nobody else dares talk to them,
if I go up and talk, I'll have them all to myself!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't that make you feel like an exclusive Trainer?
If you train me strictly, I know I'll get stronger!

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Gah, there goes Laurel's ultra-optimism again...!
Still, though... maybe you're right!

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"I'll ask a question too!
It's to get stronger, so I'm gonna cut right in,
just like Bubble!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And after school.

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I-I-Instructor!
May I ask a question?!

text_block_list.name: Drill Sergeant
text_block_list.text: ...That's unusual for you. What is it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, looks like it's going well♪
All thanks to Bubble-chan.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, shouldn't you be thanking Laurel instead?
All I did was be the first to take the plunge.
choice_data_list: Isn't it thanks to the two of them?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The super positive-thinking Sakura Laurel.
And Bubble Gum Fellow, the vanguard captain.
Those two gave her the push she needed...!
choice_data_list: Both of them have got real guts!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The super positive-thinking Sakura Laurel.
And Bubble Gum Fellow, the vanguard captain.
Those two gave her the push she needed...!
choice_data_list: Both of them have got real guts!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, exactly!
We have a drive to not lose to anyone.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Everything depends on your mindset.
If you take the plunge, a path will open up for you!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hearing it straight to my face makes me blush.
Though I completely, totally get how wonderful Laurel is!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That's my line, you know!
It's only because you showed me it could be done, Bubble-chan!
You're simply wonderful♪
